</div></div><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block sized vsize-1" data-block-type="1337" id="block-60882f662a459159a966"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" id="block-3cd6d90f855892b822e3"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">welcome to Penghu kitesurfing center...</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Penghu Kitesurfing Center is owned and run by Jan Hou and his daughter Karen Hou</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">If you are looking for an epic kitesurfing trip with guaranteed wind, Penghu is your perfect&nbsp; destination.&nbsp; Located in the middle of Taiwan Straight, the high pressure wind is squeezed and accelerated between the high mountains, up to 3000 meters, on both sides of the straits.&nbsp; The result is prevailing wind from 20 to 40 knot on a daily basis.&nbsp; It is probably the windiest place in Asia, if not in the world.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Being far away form Mainland China and Taiwan, Penghu is blessed with clean air and pristine water plus sandy beaches.&nbsp; You can choose wave or flat water spots depending on your skill levels or personal preferences.&nbsp; Hit any buttons below to find out the wind forecast of Penghu.</p>
</div>

  <p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We &nbsp;own Sunrise BnB to provide you &nbsp;clean and comfortable accommodation at affordable prices.&nbsp; We also provide you scooters and trailer for you to go to and come back from the beaches safely with minimum cost.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Need someone to pick you up from the airport? No problem, we got you covered as well. Just give us a call on your arrival, our van will arrive within 10 minutes of your call.&nbsp; You will be kitesurfing in no time.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">For any update of Jan or Karen, simply click "f" or "G+" to follow their social media sites.</p>

  <h1 class="text-align-center">Karen's XR5 Adventure in SA</h1><p class="text-align-center">After recovering from her knee injury happened in Feb. of 2017, Karen worked hard to return to kitesurfing scene.&nbsp; CORE kite launched a XR5 Challenge campaign to invite the highest booting kitesurfers around the world to Capetown SA to kite along with Joshua Emanuel.&nbsp; Karen made best use of every windy day in Penghu and jumped 19.2 meter in Dec. and won the female group.&nbsp; She flew to SA on Jan. 5th 2018 and started her adventure in SA.</p>

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">When wind is light...</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Despite Penghu is a windy island, wind sometimes can be less than 20 knot.&nbsp; It becomes a little boring for hard-core kitesurfers because the jump is not as high as you hope for and the wave is small and far in between.&nbsp; What do you do in this light wind situation?&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Don't worry!&nbsp; As kitesurfers we know what is in your mind.&nbsp; We provide hydrofoil lesson on those unexpected light wind days.&nbsp; You get 1000 NT off on our hydofoil &nbsp;lesson if you stay at our Sunrise BnB.&nbsp; The regular price is 6000 NT /2 hour. (check out the kite hydrofoil lesson and the wng foil lesson under <strong>Services</strong>.)</p>
</div>

</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-3 span-3"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block sized vsize-1" data-block-type="1337" id="block-9da10c50308b9bcb07f6"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div></div></div></div>

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h1 class="text-align-center">Playgrounds</h1><p class="text-align-center">There are many kitesurfing spots you can choose depending your skill levels and preferences.</p>

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3>Longmen Beach</h3><p>Longmen Beach is only 1 minute ride from Sunrise BnB. Wave is excellent when wind is over 30 knot.&nbsp; Best timing for the wave is one hour after high tide.&nbsp; When wind is light or tide is low, this spot becomes less wavy and more friendly to the new comers.&nbsp;</p>

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3>qinglou&nbsp; beach</h3><p>Chinglo is a flat water spot in a small cove, it is about 10 minutes ride from Sunrise BnB.&nbsp; The beach is in a small cove and water level is affected by the tides.&nbsp; &nbsp;This spot is at its best when at high tide.&nbsp; The launch spot has some sharp coral and kiters must be careful during their launches.</p>

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3>linto beach</h3><p>Linto Beach is on the south side of the island and wind is off-shore in the winter.&nbsp; The wind direction shifts to the south in the summer and is on-shore or side-on-shore.&nbsp; It becomes a perfect spot for hydrofoiling.&nbsp; This beach is about 5 minutes drive from Sunrise BnB.</p>

  class="sqs-block-button-container  sqs-block-button-container--left "

</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-1 span-1"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block sized vsize-1" data-block-type="1337" id="block-2171ab09a14886f6d984"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div></div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" id="block-adcf14a63c896b8295ed"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h1>Getting here</h1><p>Coming to Penghu is easy once you have arrived in Taiwan.&nbsp; The fastest way is coming over by planes.&nbsp; Simply choose one of three domestic airlines, Uni-Air, Mandarin, and Far East Air Transport&nbsp; (links of UniAir and Mandarin Airline provided below) and fly from one of the three domestic airports (Songsan in Taipei, Taichung and Kaohsiung) , you will reach Penghu in less than an hour. Once you arrive Penghu, call us (0956-065-509) and we will pick you up from the airport immediately.</p>
